corrections: Replaced generic fuselage with manufacturer-section-derived narrow cabin, tapered rear body, long PT6 cowling, actual transparent door/cabin apertures and separate wing/gear struts.

Authored constant1.98m chord,2.67m three-blade propeller, four flap leaves, separate ailerons/elevators/rudder, rectangular tail with balance horns, intake/exhaust recesses, landing lights and selected seams/rivets. Corrected old1.65m fuselage width to1.27m.

Rebuilt analog panel from Luigi Rosa photograph: left flight cluster, center2x3 engine stack, right radio stack, lower annunciators, central power quadrant, blue tubular crossbar, dual sticks and pedals. Added live compass in a supported housing.

Visual iteration corrected front-overlay coordinate sign, circular horizon apertures and pilot sightline. Power, sticks, pedals and flight surfaces animate; supported flight data and normalized engine RPM are live.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected all four final overlays, eight standard renders and eleven detail/state views including both control extremes, missing data, below sea level, cabin, overhead and close exterior. Final sightline/geometry and25instrument tests passed; independent candidate byte-identical.
limitations: Manufacturer model-building drawing has inconsistent cross-view details: front gear track is narrower than printed3m, and brochure tail-span5.70m disagrees with its imperial equivalent and plan. Model prioritizes printed main dimensions,1.27m section and an approximately5.12m horizontal tail including horns. Clipped half of plan is not extrapolated for comparison.

Static10.84-degree tailwheel stance is baked into the model; simulation does not resolve tailwheel ground pitch. Attitude uses labeled simulation datum. Pilot view is a high forward eye position to clear the long cowling, not a surveyed ergonomic datum.

Cockpit reference is perspective, partly occluded and only tentatively identified as F-GSAC. Uniform estimated scale and rigid7.5-degree image rotation establish relative layout, not exact panel dimensions.

TAS replaces IAS, altitude is geometric, heading true; engine gauge explicitly shows normalized simulated RPM percent. Torque, ITT, Ng, oil, fuel, radio and navigation readings remain blank/--. Prop/condition levers, electrical switches and cabin lighting do not simulate unsupported systems.
Clean landplane with six passenger seats; no floats, skis or opening doors. Upholstery, fastener spacing and flap mechanisms remain polygonal approximations. No source image pixels are distributed.
